text:
Alice (Growth): quick sync \/ CloudMesh marketplace listing + joint webinar + co-auth blog. main ask: finalize inbound lead routing and post-webinar nurture. who owns which bits?
Marco (PMM): Ill own webinar messaging + bench narrative. aiming for week of Jun 1. need UTM naming and conversion goals. :bar_chart:
Fiona (PartnerOps): Ill handle marketplace asset pack. CloudMesh needs logo (SVG), two screenshots, 3 bullets, partner blurb. partner can deliver assets by May 6.
Zoe (Content): need assets by May 10 to draft landing + blog. ask CloudMesh PM for 300-500 word guest section and a customer quote.
Raj (Sales Ops): inbound routing: webhook -> SFDC lead create with fields partner=cloudmesh, source=partner_webinar. want hot-lead Slack alerts to #sales-inbox. payload sample below.
Raj (Sales Ops): ```json
{
  "webhook":"https:\/\/hooks.redwood.ai\/lead-ingest",
  "payload":{
    "email":"{{email}}",
    "first_name":"{{first_name}}",
    "last_name":"{{last_name}}",
    "company":"{{company}}",
    "title":"{{job_title}}",
    "company_size":"{{company_size}}",
    "use_case":"{{use_case}}",
    "utm_source":"cloudmesh",
    "utm_campaign":"cloudmesh_webinar_jun1",
    "partner_tag":"cloudmesh"
  }
}
```
Alice (Growth): Fiona confirm partner will pass company_size and use_case on registration? needed for routing and SDR prioritization.
Fiona (PartnerOps): yes, they can surface those fields if registrants sign via our form. no CSV.
Priya (Legal): quick: need logo license + quote signoff. also GDPR consent language for EU registrants. please send draft consent copy.
Zoe (Content): will include consent checkbox + short privacy blurb. draft to Priya by Apr 28.
Marco (PMM): benchmark plan: short micro-benchmark comparing latency and token cost for retrieval use-case on dedicated vs shared. Zoe, can you show 1 stat + chart in blog? need numbers by May 3.
Zoe (Content): yes. Marco send minimal CSV by Apr 30.
Raj (Sales Ops): SDR routing rules: if use_case=="embeddings" and company_size>500 -> mark as P0. hot leads -> post message: "Hot Lead (CloudMesh): <name> - <company> - <title> - <use_case> - <sfdc link>" to #sales-inbox.
Alice (Growth): timeline checklist: Fiona share partner timeline May 1; Zoe draft landing + blog May 10; Marco bench data May 3; Fiona get logo/NDA to Priya by Apr 26; assets final May 12; Raj to deliver webhook + Slack integration May 20.
EventBot: Reminder: Webinar scheduled 2026-06-01 15:00 UTC.
Alice (Growth): callers: flag blockers here. well run a pre-launch dry run 48h before event. :eyes:
